# Import pkgs 

```{r}
# Check if the 'pacman' package is installed; if not, install it
if (!require(pacman)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}

# Load the required packages using pacman
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,    # Collection of R packages for data manipulation, visualization, and more
  glue,         # String interpolation and manipulation
  here,         # Simplifies working with file paths in projects
  patchwork,    # Combines multiple ggplot2 plots into one layout
  modelsummary, # Tools for summarizing and visualizing statistical models
  tinytable,    # Lightweight tables for reporting
  vroom,        # Efficient reading of large data files
  zipcodeR.     # ZIP code package 
)

library("tidylog", warn.conflicts = FALSE)

devtools::install_github("graemeblair/stdidx")
library(stdidx)

options(es.use_symbols = TRUE) # get nice symbols

source(here("functions", "utils.r"))

ggplot2::theme_set(custom_theme())
```

# Import data 

```{r}
# raw organization data from the organizations' IRS tax records and their associated websites (anonymized so it doesn't include any identifying information)

raw_org_df <- vroom(here("raw_data", "raw_org_df.csv"))
```

```{r}
# SDOH (2017-2021 ACS adapted by CDC)

## County 
sdoh_county <- read_csv(here("raw_data", "sdoh_county.csv"))

sdoh_county <- sdoh_county %>%
  select(StateAbbr, StateDesc, LocationID, MeasureID, Data_Value, TotalPopulation, Geolocation)

sdoh_county_wide <- sdoh_county %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = MeasureID, 
              values_from = Data_Value)

## Zipcode
sdoh_zcta <- read_csv(here("raw_data", "sdoh_zcta.csv")) 

sdoh_zcta <- sdoh_zcta %>%
  select(LocationID, MeasureID, Data_Value, TotalPopulation, Geolocation)

sdoh_zcta_wide <- sdoh_zcta %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = MeasureID, 
              values_from = Data_Value)
```

# Transform data 

```{r}
nrow(raw_org_df) # 1,774,798, approximately 1.8M oranizatiions in the sampling frame
```

```{r}
raw_org_df <- raw_org_df %>%
  filter(is_po != 1) # excluding those organizations whose primary mailing address is a PO BOX

nrow(raw_org_df) # 1,363,701
```
  
# Create datasets

```{r}
raw_org_df <- raw_org_df %>%
  mutate(
    opp_binary = ifelse(volunteer == 1 | membership == 1 | take_action == 1 | events == 1, 1, 0), # identify a civic opportunity organization
    opp_mean = idx_mean(volunteer, membership, take_action, events)
    ) # average civic opportunity score at the organization level

# filter civic opportunity organizations
civic_orgs <- raw_org_df %>%
  filter(opp_binary == 1)
```

## The first datasets (civic opportunity degree)

### County 

```{r}
cnts_counts <- raw_org_df %>%
  rename(FIPS = fips) %>%
  group_by(FIPS, grouping_value, state) %>% # grouping_value is needed to not double count chapters 
  summarise(
            b = max(opp_binary, na.rm = T),
            m = max(opp_mean, na.rm = T),
            volunteer_m = max(volunteer, na.rm = T),
            membership_m = max(membership, na.rm = T),
            take_action_m = max(take_action, na.rm = T),
            events_m = max(events, na.rm = T)) %>%
  group_by(FIPS, state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    civic_org_sum = sum(b),
    civic_opp_sum = sum(m),
    volunteer_sum = sum(volunteer_m), 
    membership_sum = sum(membership_m), 
    take_action_sum = sum(take_action_m), 
    events_sum = sum(events_m)
  )

cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts %>%
  inner_join(sdoh_county_wide %>%
              select(-StateDesc), 
            by = c("FIPS" = "LocationID",
                   "state" = "StateAbbr")) # n = 3,126, previously n = 3,281

cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts_cov %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
         civic_org_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_org_sum/TotalPopulation, 
         civic_opp_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_opp_sum/TotalPopulation,
         civic_opp_index = dplyr::ntile(civic_opp_sum_normalized, 5),
         volunteer_sum_normalized = 100000 * volunteer_sum/TotalPopulation,
         membership_sum_normalized = 100000 * membership_sum/TotalPopulation,
         take_action_sum_normalized = 100000 * take_action_sum/TotalPopulation,
         events_sum_normalized = 100000 * events_sum/TotalPopulation
         )

round(mean(cnts_counts$n == 0), 2) # all these counties have an organization 
round(mean(cnts_counts$civic_opp_sum == 0), 2) # 3% of the counties do not have any organization offering civic opportunity 
round(mean(cnts_counts_cov$civic_opp_sum == 0), 2) # 1% of the counties do not have any organization offering civic opportunity 

cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts_cov %>%
  select(-c("HCOST", "CROWD", "AGE65"))

# export CSV
write_csv(cnts_counts_cov, here("data_outputs", 
                                "cnty_counts_cov.csv"))

# export RDS
write_rds(cnts_counts_cov, here("data_outputs", 
                                "cnty_counts_cov.rds"))
```

### ZIP code

```{r}
zcta_counts <- raw_org_df %>%
  group_by(ZCTA, grouping_value, state) %>% # grouping_value is needed to not double count chapters 
  summarise(m = max(opp_mean, na.rm = T),
            b = max(opp_binary, na.rm = T),
            volunteer_m = max(volunteer, na.rm = T),
            membership_m = max(membership, na.rm = T),
            take_action_m = max(take_action, na.rm = T),
            events_m = max(events, na.rm = T)) %>%
  group_by(ZCTA, state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    civic_org_sum = sum(b),
    civic_opp_sum = sum(m),
    volunteer_sum = sum(volunteer_m), 
    membership_sum = sum(membership_m), 
    take_action_sum = sum(take_action_m), 
    events_sum = sum(events_m)
  )

zcta_counts_cov <- zcta_counts %>%  
  inner_join(sdoh_zcta_wide, 
            by = c("ZCTA" = "LocationID")) # n = 28,008, previously n = 30,988, missing n = 2,980 or 11%
```

```{r}
zcta_counts_cov <- zcta_counts_cov %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
         civic_org_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_org_sum/TotalPopulation, 
         civic_opp_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_opp_sum/TotalPopulation,
         civic_opp_index = dplyr::ntile(civic_opp_sum_normalized, 5),
         volunteer_sum_normalized = 100000 * volunteer_sum/TotalPopulation,
         membership_sum_normalized = 100000 * membership_sum/TotalPopulation,
         take_action_sum_normalized = 100000 * take_action_sum/TotalPopulation,
         events_sum_normalized = 100000 * events_sum/TotalPopulation
         )

round(mean(zcta_counts$n == 0), 2) # all these ZIP codes have an organization
round(mean(zcta_counts$civic_opp_sum == 0), 2) # 17% of the ZIP codes do not have any organization offering civic opportunity 
round(mean(zcta_counts_cov$civic_opp_sum == 0), 2) # 15% of the ZIP codes do not have any organization offering civic opportunity 
```

```{r}
zcta_counts_cov <- zcta_counts_cov %>%
  select(-c("HCOST", "CROWD", "AGE65"))

# export CSV
write_csv(zcta_counts_cov, here("data_outputs", 
                                "zcta_counts_cov.csv"))

# export RDS
write_csv(zcta_counts_cov, here("data_outputs", 
                                "zcta_counts_cov.rds"))
```

## The second datasets (the civic opportunity kind)

```{r}
civic_orgs <- civic_orgs %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(class = case_match(predicted,
                            class_vec[1] ~ "Arts & Cultural",
                            class_vec[2] ~ "Political",
                            class_vec[3] ~ "Community",
                            class_vec[4] ~ "Economic",
                            class_vec[5] ~ "Education",
                            class_vec[6] ~ "Foundations",
                            class_vec[7] ~ "Healthcare",
                            class_vec[8] ~ "Hobby & Sports",
                            class_vec[9] ~ "Housing",
                            class_vec[10] ~ "Professional",
                            class_vec[11] ~ "Religious",
                            class_vec[12] ~ "Research & Think Tank",
                            class_vec[13] ~ "Social & Fraternal",
                            class_vec[14] ~ "Unions",
                            class_vec[15] ~ "Youth"))
```

### County

```{r}
cnty_civic_org_type <- civic_orgs %>%
  group_by(fips, class) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(fips) %>%
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(fips) %>%
  mutate(primary_org_cat = class[which.max(freq)]) %>%
  ungroup()

cnty_civic_org_type <- cnty_civic_org_type %>%
  rename(FIPS = fips)
```

#### Dashboard 

```{r}
cnty_civic_org_type_dashboard <- civic_orgs %>%
  group_by(state, fips, class) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(fips) %>%
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(fips) %>%
  mutate(primary_org_cat = class[which.max(freq)]) %>%
  ungroup()

cnty_civic_type_dashboard <- cnty_civic_org_type_dashboard %>%
  inner_join(sdoh_county_wide %>%
              select(-StateDesc), 
            by = c("fips" = "LocationID",
                   "state" = "StateAbbr")) %>% # n
  select(state, fips, class, n, freq, primary_org_cat, TotalPopulation) %>%
  mutate(normalized_n = n/TotalPopulation) %>%
  select(state, fips, class, n, normalized_n, freq, primary_org_cat, TotalPopulation)

# export CSV
write_csv(cnty_civic_type_dashboard, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_type_dashboard"))
```

```{r}
# export CSV
write_csv(cnty_civic_org_type, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_org_type.csv"))

# export RDS
write_rds(cnty_civic_org_type, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_org_type.rds"))
```
